title: Colonizer webhook event, version 1
description: One JSON note the notify module POSTs to a webhook (docs/protocol/webhooks.md). Every event has the same eight keys. `version` changes only when a key changes meaning or goes away; a new event name or a new key does not change it, so receivers must ignore event names and keys they do not know. No payload carries repository content (issue titles, questions, branches, errors) or a secret. The `event` list is checked against the harness (crates/colonizer/src/notify.rs EVENT_NAMES) by a test.

id.description: The event's stable id, also sent as the X-Colonizer-Event-Id header. The same event always carries the same id; receivers dedupe on it.

event.description: What happened. The first sixteen are the colony lifecycle: one per status transition, plus `cleaned`; the rest are the events a person is told about and the host-level ones.

at.description: When the mothership built this note.

text.description: One short line naming the repository and issue, or the provider, and what happened.

colony.description: The colony the event is about, or null on a host-level event.

pr_url.description: The colony's pull request on `pull_request` and `needs_rebase`; null otherwise.

provider.description: The provider behind `provider_degraded`, `judge_degraded` or `provider_quota_exhausted`; null otherwise.
